assay_or_perturbation: SEMA3A/NRP1-Plexin-A binding and receptor-relay assays; neurite/growth-cone responses
evidence_summary: SEMA3A signaling through neuropilin/Plexin-A complexes was associated with axon guidance and growth-cone repulsion.
limitations: The exact Plexin-A paralog and terminal TF are context-dependent; no SCI-specific terminal program was established.

cell_type_or_model: developing forebrain neurons and PlexinD1 models
assay_or_perturbation: SEMA3E/PLXND1 perturbation; neuropilin gating; axon guidance and RhoA/actin assays
evidence_summary: SEMA3E/PLXND1 signaling controlled axon guidance with neuropilin-dependent switching between repulsion and attraction and downstream actin regulation.
limitations: Developmental and vascular/immune comparator contexts; no terminal TF target assigned.

assay_or_perturbation: SLIT1/ROBO2 perturbation; N-cadherin/cytoskeletal and axon-patterning assays
evidence_summary: SLIT1/ROBO2 signaling was associated with N-cadherin/cytoskeletal guidance and ganglion or olfactory axon patterning.
limitations: No terminal TF or SCI-specific output was assigned.

assay_or_perturbation: SLIT3/ROBO1 perturbation; migration and survival assays
evidence_summary: SLIT3/ROBO1 signaling was associated with cardiac neural-crest migration, survival and cardiovascular development.
limitations: Developmental comparator only; no terminal TF target or SCI-specific receiver-cell claim.
